breakdown: ✅ Panthers are at full strength.
📋 Panthers come in 6-6, Jets 4-7 - the record backs our side.
📊 Offense: Panthers are putting up 2.8 a game on the season, Jets 2.5.
🏟️ Jets at home this season: 2-4. Nothing scary about that.
📅 Fresh off: Panthers W 3-2 @ Blackhawks · Jets L 1-2 vs Canadiens.
🍀 Puck luck's been shit for Panthers: a 97.0 PDO over the last 10. That snaps back.
📊 The public's with us: 80% of the bets, 54% of the money on the Panthers.
⚠️ Ain't gonna lie - Clay Stevenson (Jets) is at a 0.894 save % over his last 3 starts to Akira Schmid's 0.868. That's the risk here, and it's already in the price.
🟡 Bottom line: Panthers (-130). We like Panthers to win it. The price is too fair to bet - just a lean.
🧳 The Canadiens: 3rd road game in 6 days.
🚑 Canadiens are missing Nick Suzuki (C). Short-handed against us.
⏳ Blues got the extra day: 3 days off to Canadiens' 2 days.
⚖️ 5-6 against 6-5 - nothing in it on paper. The matchup's where Blues win this.
⚠️ Fair warning - Jacob Fowler (Canadiens) is at a 0.938 save % over his last 3 starts to Jordan Binnington's 0.831. We weighed it, and Blues is still the side.
🟡 Bottom line: Blues (-118). Right side, but the price costs about what they're worth. A lean.
📊 Lately Spurs score 112 and allow 112 a game; Kings score 109 and allow 124. Edge us on the scoreboard.
🛌 Spurs come in with 2 more days of rest.
🚑 Kings are without Dylan Cardwell (C), Maxime Raynaud (C), Keegan Murray (F), Ben Simmons (G). Bodies missing over there.
🗑️ Nothing about Kings scares us (0-3).
🧳 The Kings: 1,460-mile trip east.
🚀 Spurs just beat the brakes off the Mavericks, 122-106.
📅 Most recent games: Spurs W 122-106 @ Mavericks · Kings L 112-123 vs Grizzlies.
🥊 The Kings got their cheeks clapped 121-96 by the Clippers inside their last 5.
⚠️ What the other side's gonna say: Spurs go without Tobias Harris (F), Jayden Quaintance (F). True. Still ain't enough to flip us.
🟡 Bottom line: Spurs -18.5 (-108). Spurs -18.5 is near 50-50 to cover on our read. Lean only. The Spurs sit 1-2; the Kings sit 0-3.
🛡️ Mammoth is leaking 3.3 goals a game this season. Wild holds teams to 2.3.
🥅 The Mammoth's goalie Karel Vejmelka can't keep the puck out lately: a 0.817 save % (13 goals on 71 shots) over his last 3 starts.
🔥 Wild (8-5) won 2 in a row and they ain't done. Say less.
🚑 Out for Mammoth: John Marino (D). That's real depth gone.
🥊 The Mammoth got smacked 6-2 by the Oilers inside their last 5. That's who we're going against.
📅 Both coming off W's - Wild a 4-2 win over the Canucks, Mammoth a 5-4 win over the Lightning.
⚖️ Wild 8-5, Mammoth 8-4 - a wash on paper, and the book's paying us plus money to take Wild.
⚠️ The one thing that worries us: Wild are 4-5 on the road this year. Priced in. We still riding.
✅ Bottom line: Wild at +102. Thin one - the dog check backs it, our read calls it about even. Half a unit.
📊 Delaware at 28 points a game this year. Western KY at 21. Ours scores more, that's just facts.
🥊 New Mexico St spanked Western KY 34-13 within their last 5 games.
🎯 Our quarterback's been better: Nick Minicucci has 8 TDs, 3 picks and 709 yards in his last 3 games for Delaware; Brock Glenn has 2 TDs, 1 pick and 478 yards in his last 3 games for Western KY.
📋 Both sides 3-4: Delaware and Western KY walk in with the same record.
📅 Delaware just took a 61-38 win over Missouri St; Western KY just took a 16-3 win over Sam Houston. Two winners walk in, one walks out.
⚠️ The risk: Western KY come in on a 2-game heater. Everything above is why we take it anyway.
✅ Bottom line: Delaware (+102). Not a big edge on the price - the dog check likes Delaware here. Half a unit, keep it light.
